scenes.title: Lock random notes to pentatonic: On

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Set the random-note option
steps.caption: Open PARAMS > MOSAIC. Set Lock random to pent. On.

steps.title: Hear the random-note phrase
steps.caption: Use Random Note 4 with Twos Random Note 0. Nonzero random offsets snap to the five-note selection; zero offsets preserve their note.

scenes.title: Lock random notes to pentatonic: Off

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Set the random-note option
steps.caption: Open PARAMS > MOSAIC. Set Lock random to pent. Off.

steps.title: Hear the random-note phrase
steps.caption: Use Random Note 4 with Twos Random Note 0. Random offsets use the seven-note scale without pentatonic snapping.

scenes.title: Lock merged notes to pentatonic: On

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Set the merged-note option
steps.caption: Open PARAMS > MOSAIC. Set Lock merged to pent. On.

steps.title: Hear the averaged phrase
steps.caption: Assign two patterns and select Average note merge. The four resulting MIDI pitches are 62, 64, 69, 64.

scenes.title: Lock merged notes to pentatonic: Off

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Set the merged-note option
steps.caption: Open PARAMS > MOSAIC. Set Lock merged to pent. Off.

steps.title: Hear the averaged phrase
steps.caption: Assign two patterns and select Average note merge. The four resulting MIDI pitches are 62, 65, 69, 65.

scenes.title: Set Tempo and feel across Song slots

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Set Tempo 30
steps.caption: Open Song tasks > Tempo and feel. Set Tempo 30 BPM, apply with K3 and play slot 1. Notes and gates follow this tempo.

steps.title: Set Tempo 300
steps.caption: Open Song tasks > Tempo and feel. Set Tempo 300 BPM, apply with K3 and play slot 2. Notes and gates follow this tempo.

steps.title: Set Tempo 90
steps.caption: Open Song tasks > Tempo and feel. Set Tempo 90 BPM, apply with K3 and play slot 1. Notes and gates follow this tempo.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Copy a populated slot
steps.caption: Copy slot 1 to slot 2 and select slot 2. Slot 1 is mid-bright, slot 2 is bright and empty slot 3 is dim.

assertion.characterisation: Stopped selected slot is also bright (outside the README playing-only wording).

steps.title: Play the selected slot
steps.caption: Press Play. Slot 2 remains bright while its four-note phrase plays; slot 1 remains mid-bright and empty slot 3 remains dim.

assertion.characterisation: Stopped selected slot is also bright (outside the README playing-only wording).

steps.title: Queue a different slot
steps.caption: While slot2 plays, press slot1. Slot1 blinks dimmer and brighter while slot2 remains bright until the sequence ends.

assertion.characterisation: Characterisation outside README: populated queued slot alternates exact LED levels1/7 on the source0.4s blink clock; controlled samples are exactly0.4s apart. Real native visual dwell bounds derive from the20Hz grid flush plus the existing10ms clock allowance; fast observations do not assume the global blink phase.

steps.title: Hear the queued slot take over
steps.caption: At the sequence boundary, slot1 becomes bright and its octave-higher phrase begins. Slot2 returns to mid-bright.

steps.title: Erase by copying an empty slot
steps.caption: Stop, copy empty slot 3 over slot 2, then select slot 1. Slots 2 and 3 are dim.

assertion.characterisation: Stopped selected slot is also bright (outside the README playing-only wording).

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Set Repeats 1
steps.caption: Open Song tasks > Slot setup. Repeats starts at 1 for this copied slot.

steps.title: Set Repeats 16
steps.caption: Open Song tasks > Slot setup. Select Repeats with E2, set 16 with E3 and apply with K3.

steps.title: Set Repeats 2
steps.caption: Open Song tasks > Slot setup. Select Repeats with E2, set 2 with E3 and apply with K3.

scenes.title: Turn screen motion on or off

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Set UI motion Off
steps.caption: Open PARAMS > MOSAIC. In the Screen section, set UI motion Off.

steps.title: Select a field without hiding its value
steps.caption: Open Channel tasks > Clock. Set Clock Mod to /1.5 with E3 and apply with K3, then restore /1. All labels and values stay readable while the title mark remains still.
